name: Mera Work
summary: Employee monitoring and time tracking for remote, hybrid and office teams: automatic timesheets, attendance and shifts, app and website usage, screenshots and live screen view, all in one per-user plan.
best_for: small and mid-sized teams, especially remote or hybrid ones doing computer-based work such as support, BPO, IT services or back office, that want time tracking, attendance and activity monitoring under one per-user price without paying extra for screenshots or live view
skip_if: you need more than 90 days of history in the tool and cannot negotiate it, or you want a plain timer with no monitoring at all: Mera Work told us in writing on 25 November 2026 that a self-starting timer exists, but we have not tested it, and in our test new users got monitoring switched on by default
honest_knock:
The price is low and the feature list is long; the catch sits in the data rather than the bill. Mera Work keeps your records for 90 days. The pricing table says data retention up to three months, and the privacy policy spells it out: unless your order form says otherwise, customer data is held on a rolling 90-day basis and anything older may be deleted automatically from production. That rules it out as the place you look back from over a year: an annual review, a client disputing hours billed last spring, a payroll audit. Export the timesheets and attendance you need every month, or get a longer retention period written into the order form before you roll it out.

This is monitoring software, not only a timer. The feature table lists screenshots, live screen streaming, keyboard and mouse activity tracking and a stealth mode. Mera Work's own pages are more careful than the word keystroke suggests: its keystroke feature records how much typing happened and when, not the keys or words themselves, and screenshots can be blurred and limited by role. But whether you may run screenshots, live view or a hidden agent on your staff's computers is a question for your employment adviser, not the vendor, and data-protection rules in Europe generally expect employees to be told what is recorded. Decide the policy first and tell people what the agent captures.

Two practical points. The company behind it, Aapna Infotheek Private Limited, is based in New Delhi, and its privacy policy says data may be hosted or processed in India. The hosting page, read 25 November 2026, says the standard cloud runs on Microsoft Azure in India, the UAE, Australia and the United States, with private cloud and on premise reserved for enterprise customers; if location matters, ask which region your account lands in and put it in the contract. And the review sites we normally read, Capterra and G2, blocked our reader on 30 September 2026. The one we could read, SoftwareSuggest, shows six reviews from 2025 under the old name Mera Monitor, and one of the three visible there also runs as a testimonial on Mera Work's own pricing page, so we found no clearly independent account of reliability or support to weigh. We have not run Mera Work ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-30 on mera.work/pricing, INR and USD tabs, and on mera.work/signup) One plan, priced per user, with every feature included: the page states there are no feature restrictions and no add-ons. In US dollars it is $4 per user a month billed monthly or $3 per user a month billed annually, which the page describes as saving $12 per user a year. In rupees the same plan is ₹325 per user a month billed monthly or ₹250 billed annually, saving ₹900 per user a year. Enterprise is a custom quote for 1,000 or more users. The sign-up page offers a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan with no credit card and says the subscription starts only if you choose to continue. The feature table lists data retention of up to three months, and the privacy policy puts that into practice: unless your order form says otherwise, customer data is kept on a rolling 90-day basis and older data may be deleted automatically. A 50% inaugural discount for July that appeared in earlier readings is no longer shown.

compare_with.name: Hubstaff
compare_with.why: Hubstaff is the closest comparison in our own dossiers. On our reading of 29 August 2026 Hubstaff's Starter was $4.99 per seat a month billed annually or $7 billed monthly, with a two-seat minimum, and its Grow and Team tiers were $7.50 and $10 billed annually. Mera Work, read on 30 September 2026, is $3 per user a month billed annually or $4 monthly for a single plan that already includes screenshots, live screen streaming, attendance and shift tools. On price Mera Work is lower at every team size. What you give up is history and outside evidence: Mera Work keeps 90 days of data by default, and the only review site we could read holds six reviews from 2025. A team that mainly wants to see who is working today can start with Mera Work's trial; one that needs a year of records in the tool should price Hubstaff's tiers first.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Mera Work without the desktop agent: the onboarding wizard that was skipped, the default settings for new users (Capture Screenshot switched on and saved), the general settings, an empty Time Tracker report, the plan page in rupees with a required GST number, My Plans without an active plan and the user menu. No member was added, no agent was installed and nothing was paid. The test ran in an account that we made, on 17 November 2026 from 13:57, in our own tab; the app is in English. A cookie banner (We value your privacy) was answered by refusing the non-essential cookies. The dashboard opened straight into an onboarding wizard, Step 1 (1/3) Configure Tracking Rules, with the questions Laptop Ownership (Company Laptop recommended or Personal Laptop) and Tracking Mode (Stealth or Interactive, Interactive recommended). The wizard was not continued; we went to the settings instead. Core action, setting the default settings for users (no desktop agent was installed): Configuration, User Default Settings, Capture Screenshot switched on, Save. It took about 2 minutes (13:58 to 14:00) and 4 steps. Before: Capture Screenshot Off, Live Stream Off, Monitoring On, Stealth Mode Off, Notification Off, Stop Timer Enable On, Work Mode Off, View Screenshots Off, Personal System Off, Allow Logout Off. After saving a toast said Success, Configuration updated successfully., and Capture Screenshot showed On. A line says These configurations will only apply to newly added users., so the change does nothing until a user is added. General Settings: Screenshot Interval 5 min (range 1 to 30), Screenshot Blur Effect 0 (0 to 3), Capture Keyboard Mouse Stroke 10 min (10 to 60), Idle Time Interval 5 min (2 to 30), Time Zone India Standard Time, Attendance Hours Per Day 08:00:00, Working Days Mon to Fri, and the mail alerts for Suspicious Keyboard, Start Stop and Idle Time all Off. A retention period was NOT found in General Settings, User Default Settings or Cloud Settings; Cloud Settings only shows Cloud Storage For, Select Storage For and Update. Stealth Mode exists as a switch (Off) under User Default Settings and as a choice in the wizard. Report: the Time Tracker report (Organization View, 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-17) shows only zeros, with Total Team Productivity 00:00:00, because there is no data without the desktop agent. No member was added and no invitation was sent. Plans: Pricing and Billing, Plans says One plan. All features, with the switch Auto-Renew or One Time and Cancel any time. The choices are INR Annual Billing at 3000 rupees per user per year and INR Monthly Billing at 325 rupees per user per month. The form asks for Organization Name, No of License, a required GST Number (GST Number is required), State and Billing Address, and a note says that GST (18%) will be applied on the plan amount. The button Continue to billing was not used. What is included: Activity and Productivity Tracking, Screenshots and Activity Timeline, Idle Time Detection and Online or Offline Activity Tracking, among others. My Plans says You do not have any active plan. and no 14 day trial was visible; History says No Payment History Found. The amounts are in rupees with GST on top, not the dollar prices of the dossier. Checkout: not reached; the form needs a GST number and the button to continue to billing was not used, so no approval or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: there was no active payment, so nothing could be cancelled. The user menu only has Help, Profile and Sign Out; Profile has contact details, two-factor authentication (Disabled), billing and Change Password, and no button to delete or close the account was found. Nothing was deleted. Not tested: the desktop agent (Download Mera Work), live streaming, screenshots with real data, anomaly analysis, the real retention period of 90 days, reports with data, adding a member, paying, Time Claim, Project and Task. Clean up: the account and the organization remain; the default setting Capture Screenshot is now On (it was Off) and only applies to newly added users, and it can be switched back. No members, no invitations and no agent. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The onboarding wizard appears before anything else and asks for a tracking mode including Stealth, the changed default only applies to newly added users, the plan page needs a GST number and shows rupees only, no 14 day trial and no retention period were visible, and no way to delete or close the account was found.
